snippet.title: G.NA - TOP GIRL
snippet.description:
2011.08.23 OUT!
2nd MINI ALBUM TITLE 'TOP GIRL'

'Top Girl'이 된 G.NA의 두 번째 미니앨범

G.NA는 여성 솔로임에도 K-POP 시장에 큰 이슈를 던지는 흔치 않은 아티스트이다. 그런 그녀가 남다른 열정으로 완성시킨 두 번째 미니앨범 'Top Girl' 역시 팬들을 열광시키기에 충분하다. 타이틀 곡 'Top Girl'은 데뷔부터 함께해온 히트메이커 김도훈, 이상호 프로듀서가 작곡하고, G.NA와 함께 다수의 감각적인 곡 작업을 선보였던 휘성이 작사한 매력 넘치는 트랙이다. 중독성 강한 멜로디와 세련된 사운드가 제목처럼 당당하고 자신감 있는 G.NA의 '톡톡톡' 튀는 매력을 한껏 드러낸다. 또한 'Banana'는 G.NA가 직접 가사에 참여한 곡으로 'I going bananas'(미치겠다)라는 가사가 독특하고 재기 넘치는 사운드를 들려준다.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Many Korean boy and girl groups have made a big success but as a female solo artist, G.NA rather unusually has made quite an impression in the K-Pop scene. And now she has put the greatest efforts to make the second mini album 'Top Girl' which has such an outstanding quality that would thrill her fans.  
The title single 'Top Girl' was produced by hitmakers Kim, Do-Hoon and Lee, Sang-Ho who she has worked with since her debut and Wheesung, who is also a singer and has worked with G.NA on a few projects, wrote the lines for 'Top Girl'. Addictive melody lines and such sophisticated sounds present confidence and charms that G.NA has just like 'Top Girl'.

snippet.title: G.NA - CKFF 2011 Kpop Festival
snippet.description:
4:30 -- 8:30PM, Sunday, February 27, 2011
@ Bell Performing Arts Centre 6250 144th Street, Surrey, BC V3X 1A1

In partnership with Cube Entertainment of Korea, there had been a Youtube contest to find the next Cube Superstar from Canada from December 27, 2010 -- January 27, 2011.   Over 4000 participants and a millions of viewers have participated in selecting the top 15 contestants to perform at the CKFF -- Kpop Festival 2011 on February 27, 2011 at Bell Performing Arts Centre in Surrey, BC.   At the festival the top prize winner will have the opportunity to become a Kpop Superstar under the Cube Management.  

Also at the Festival, G.NA (Gina Choi), originally from Surrey, BC (born and raised) and now a Kpop superstar in Korea will be making her premier performance in her home county.

snippet.title: G.NA - TOP GIRL
snippet.description:
2011.08.23 OUT!
2nd MINI ALBUM TITLE 'TOP GIRL'

'Top Girl'이 된 G.NA의 두 번째 미니앨범

G.NA는 여성 솔로임에도 K-POP 시장에 큰 이슈를 던지는 흔치 않은 아티스트이다. 그런 그녀가 남다른 열정으로 완성시킨 두 번째 미니앨범 'Top Girl' 역시 팬들을 열광시키기에 충분하다. 타이틀 곡 'Top Girl'은 데뷔부터 함께해온 히트메이커 김도훈, 이상호 프로듀서가 작곡하고, G.NA와 함께 다수의 감각적인 곡 작업을 선보였던 휘성이 작사한 매력 넘치는 트랙이다. 중독성 강한 멜로디와 세련된 사운드가 제목처럼 당당하고 자신감 있는 G.NA의 '톡톡톡' 튀는 매력을 한껏 드러낸다. 또한 'Banana'는 G.NA가 직접 가사에 참여한 곡으로 'I going bananas'(미치겠다)라는 가사가 독특하고 재기 넘치는 사운드를 들려준다.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Many Korean boy and girl groups have made a big success but as a female solo artist, G.NA rather unusually has made quite an impression in the K-Pop scene. And now she has put the greatest efforts to make the second mini album 'Top Girl' which has such an outstanding quality that would thrill her fans.  
The title single 'Top Girl' was produced by hitmakers Kim, Do-Hoon and Lee, Sang-Ho who she has worked with since her debut and Wheesung, who is also a singer and has worked with G.NA on a few projects, wrote the lines for 'Top Girl'. Addictive melody lines and such sophisticated sounds present confidence and charms that G.NA has just like 'Top Girl'.

snippet.title: G.NA - CKFF 2011 Kpop Festival
snippet.description:
4:30 -- 8:30PM, Sunday, February 27, 2011
@ Bell Performing Arts Centre 6250 144th Street, Surrey, BC V3X 1A1

In partnership with Cube Entertainment of Korea, there had been a Youtube contest to find the next Cube Superstar from Canada from December 27, 2010 -- January 27, 2011.   Over 4000 participants and a millions of viewers have participated in selecting the top 15 contestants to perform at the CKFF -- Kpop Festival 2011 on February 27, 2011 at Bell Performing Arts Centre in Surrey, BC.   At the festival the top prize winner will have the opportunity to become a Kpop Superstar under the Cube Management.  

Also at the Festival, G.NA (Gina Choi), originally from Surrey, BC (born and raised) and now a Kpop superstar in Korea will be making her premier performance in her home county.
